# The map of packages/blueprint-tools

One line per file, in what the file says of itself. The kinds of folder are in [README.md](../README.md).

## `src/checks/`

- [`code-text.ts`](../src/checks/code-text.ts): What of a file is code, for the count of old words (old-words.ts): a file's text split into pieces of code, string literals and Markdown code, with every comment and every line of Markdown prose left out.
- [`declared-names.ts`](../src/checks/declared-names.ts): Every name the blueprint declares, in one set: each operation's name, each refusal's tag, the tag of each event and of each kind of success an operation declares, and each starting world's name.
- [`delta.ts`](../src/checks/delta.ts): The delta check (docs/roadmap.md, "Typed once, by check", step 3.5): every operation has every format that exists (formats.ts), or is on that format's `unmigrated` list, which may only shrink.
- [`format.ts`](../src/checks/format.ts): What a format is, as the delta check (delta.ts) reads it: a shape of declaration every operation must have once it exists (docs/roadmap.md, "Typed once, by check" and "New formats by a ratchet").
- [`formats.ts`](../src/checks/formats.ts): Every format an operation's declaration must have, by name (docs/roadmap.md, steps 3.5 and 3.10; docs/design/ blueprint.md, part 14, part 1): `pnpm delta:check` fails an operation that lacks one, unless the blueprint lists it in that format's `unmigrated` list.
- [`machine-format.ts`](../src/checks/machine-format.ts): The machine format, as the delta check reads it (docs/roadmap.md, "Typed once, by check", step 3.5): an operation meets it when it starts or moves some machine (../language/lifecycle.ts) and every move it makes declares what happens from every state it cannot start from, each refusal one the operation declares; or when its verb declares it stateless, with a reason.
- [`old-words.ts`](../src/checks/old-words.ts): The rename ratchet, R15 "Old words" in the blueprint's registry (packages/blueprint/src/ratchets.ts; docs/roadmap.md, item 3.8): how many distinct names in code still hold each old word of the glossary.
- [`operation-formats.ts`](../src/checks/operation-formats.ts): The formats an operation's own declaration meets (docs/design/blueprint.md, parts 9, 10 and 14, part 1; roadmap item 3.10), beside the machine format (./machine-format.ts): who may call it, its spans, its logs and the log of each refusal it decides, its budget, its promises, and its telemetry names.
- [`ratchet-files.ts`](../src/checks/ratchet-files.ts): The ratchets counted from the repository's files (roadmap item 3.6): R7, the verbs whose examples still sit in their thing's `examples.ts`; R8, the long READMEs, the hand-written file maps and the docs not yet folded; R10, the non-Effect constructs and runtime dependencies.
- [`ratchets.ts`](../src/checks/ratchets.ts): The ratchets counted (docs/design/blueprint.md, part 4; roadmap item 3.6): each ratchet of the blueprint's registry (packages/blueprint/src/ratchets.ts) tallied by its counter from the lists that hold it today, compared with the committed counts (packages/blueprint/generated/ratchets.json).
- [`scorecard.ts`](../src/checks/scorecard.ts): The scorecard (roadmap item 3.11; docs/design/blueprint.md, part 14): every thing of the blueprint against every format and per-thing ratchet, each cell ✓, ✗, "not yet measured", or "—" where it does not apply; and every ratchet's count beneath.
- [`word-files.ts`](../src/checks/word-files.ts): Which files the count of old words reads (old-words.ts): `packages/`, `AGENTS.md`, `docs/roadmap.md`, `docs/decisions.md` and `.github/`.

## `src/`

- [`index.ts`](../src/index.ts): The toolkit's one door: the language the blueprint is written in (a verb, a refusal, an event, work no door serves, a lifecycle, a promise, a starting point, a ratchet, how a generated index gathers its parts), the checks (the formats and the delta check, declared names, old words, ratchets and the scorecard), the pages it renders, and how the blueprint's folders read as data.

## `src/language/`

- [`gather.ts`](../src/language/gather.ts): How a generated index of the blueprint is composed from its parts: one record holding every entry of each part's record of one name.
- [`glossary.ts`](../src/language/glossary.ts): The glossary's format (docs/design/blueprint.md, part 12, decision 7): one word, one meaning.
- [`kinds.ts`](../src/language/kinds.ts): One constructor per kind of declaration, each marking what it makes (docs/design/blueprint.md, part 13, "Amended", point 2): `refusal(...)`, a tagged error carrying its exit code on its own declaration; `event(...)`, a tagged class; and `verb(...)` (./operation.ts), an operation.
- [`lifecycle.ts`](../src/language/lifecycle.ts): The machine format (docs/roadmap.md, "Lifecycles are machines in the blueprint", step 3.4): a thing with a lifecycle that callers see and refusals depend on is declared once, in its thing's `lifecycle.ts`, as its states, its start, and its moves.
- [`operation.ts`](../src/language/operation.ts): What one operation declares beyond its Rpc: the events each kind of success emits, what each event must carry, how fast the call must be and what that number measures, and one worked example per kind of success.
- [`promise.ts`](../src/language/promise.ts): What a promise is (today's word in the code: an acceptance claim, `Claim`, until the glossary's rename).
- [`ratchet.ts`](../src/language/ratchet.ts): What a ratchet is (docs/design/blueprint.md, part 4; roadmap items 3.6 and 3.11): a gap between old work and the blueprint, declared once in the blueprint's registry, whose list may only shrink.
- [`starting-point.ts`](../src/language/starting-point.ts): What a starting point is (today's word in the code: a starting world): a named state a journey begins from, made through the door by the blueprint's own operations from the one before it.
- [`work.ts`](../src/language/work.ts): Work no door serves: the pipeline's own operations (docs/design/blueprint.md, part 8), such as a world's reset, a run's verdict or the gate.

## `src/render/`

- [`glance.ts`](../src/render/glance.ts): Renders the four lists a thing's page opens with (docs/design/blueprint.md, part 13, amended 15 November 2026): its commands, its SDK calls, the refusals its verbs answer with each one's exit code, and the events they send.
- [`glossary.ts`](../src/render/glossary.ts): The glossary's page (packages/blueprint/generated/glossary.md), from the blueprint's glossary.
- [`layout.ts`](../src/render/layout.ts): The blueprint's folders read as data: each thing (a folder under src/things/), its verbs (one file each under the thing's verbs/: an operation with its Rpc, or work no door serves) and its thing files, from the files' text alone, so `pnpm generate` can write the generated indexes even when the ones on disk are out of date, and the renderer can say which verbs are whose.
- [`machines.ts`](../src/render/machines.ts): Renders a thing's lifecycle (the format is ../language/lifecycle.ts) into its page: its states, start and moves, and its diagram, generated from the declaration, never typed.
- [`render.ts`](../src/render/render.ts): Renders the blueprint's pages from its declarations, into packages/blueprint/generated/: index.md, with what every promise shares, the map of every thing and its verbs, and the starting points; and one page per thing, with its lifecycle and each of its verbs' promises, refusals, events and budget, so that a change to one thing renders only its own page.
- [`work.ts`](../src/render/work.ts): Renders a thing's work no door serves (the format is ../language/work.ts) into its page: what each piece does, its payload, its spans in order with their kinds, its logs with their fields, and its budget, a target.
